_about: Every known point where Operators/Focus, Amps, Companions, companion weapons and mod sets touch the Warframe/weapon damage calculation. pipeline_step refers to the 20-step list in CLAUDE.md (null = no step: indirect or survivability). Values are max rank unless stated.
_sources: Numbers come from the files under data/raw/operator, amps, companions and companion_mods (wiki.warframe.com data modules, October 2026). 'confidence' is 'data' when the number is in game/wiki data, 'wiki note' when the stacking rule comes from a wiki note, 'unverified' when it rests on general game knowledge and needs an in-game check.
_corrections_to_the_brief: Madurai Phoenix Talons is +30% Physical damage (and Operator damage), not Heat.
Flame Blast, Phoenix Spirit, Void Stalker, Sundering Dash and Hardened-armor style nodes are Focus 2.0 ways that no longer exist; they are kept in the focus files with status 'legacy'.
Naramon has no 'Surging Grasp'; initial combo comes from mods/arcanes. Naramon's combo nodes are Power Spike and Opening Slam.
Unairu has no 'Reinforcing Pillars'; the armor node is Stone Skin (+200 armor to Warframe and Operator).
Zenurik Hardened Wellspring grants +20% Ability Strength, not armor.
Link mods are named Link Vitality / Link Redirection / Link Fiber.
Vizier is a Predasite, not a Vulpaphyla; the third Vulpaphyla is Sly.
Mecha set mods go on Kubrows and Predasites; Tek set mods on Kavats. Mecha Empowered is a Warframe aura.
Tek Assault gives the Kavat a chance to ignore lethal damage; it is not a damage boost.

open_questions: Do Warframe damage auras and squad damage buffs apply to companion weapons?
Is Killer's Rush flat points or a multiplier? Same for Temporal Shot and Ambush.
Do companions gain stats with rank? Current data shows a single value per companion.
Per-hit damage multipliers of the Drifter's Duviri melee combos are not published.
Exact quantization behaviour for amps and companion weapons has not been tested in game.
